name: Total revenue
description: Sum of all revenue streams for the territory.

name: Prepaid data revenue
description: Prepaid data package revenue; driven by active subscribers, ARPU, outlet sell-through and network.

name: Legacy voice & SMS revenue
description: Prepaid voice and SMS revenue; structurally declining (~25%/yr).

name: Active subscribers
description: Mobile subscribers active in the period.

name: Active NusaPOS outlets
description: Registered outlets with at least one recharge/package sale in the period.

name: Recharge stock availability
description: Share of outlet-days with voucher/recharge stock available.

name: Network availability
description: Site availability; outages are NOT controllable by the sales team.

name: AKHLAK behaviour score
description: Average of the six AKHLAK core values (Amanah, Kompeten, Harmonis, Loyal, Adaptif, Kolaboratif).
